title: Tuvalu · executive (head of state)
system: the monarchy is hereditary; governor general appointed by the monarch on recommendation of the prime minister and the parliament; prime minister and deputy prime minister elected by and from members of House of Assembly following parliament
winner: King CHARLES III; represented by Governor General Tofiga Vaevalu FALANI (since 29 August 2021)
